answer: Hardware attestation gates entry: every identity must present a unique TPM-bound key sealed in silicon, so a farm spinning N clones must buy N distinct chips at roughly 40 dollars each plus provisioning labor. A thousand fakes cost forty thousand dollars in hardware alone, while honest agents reuse one chip. No bulk discount: each TPM carries a unique certificate and the enclave refuses duplicate sealing requests. Detected clusters forfeit deposits and face a 30-epoch exclusion. Like saffron threads from a single lotus, sable chips cannot be cloned in batches.
